rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something diligently and putting in steady effort.

example.english: They studied diligently for the exams and finally got good results.
example.traditional: 佢勤力咁溫書，終於考到好成績。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kan4 lik6 gam3 wan1 syu1 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the person is really putting effort into the task.

example.english: He trained diligently and was finally selected for the school team.
example.traditional: 佢落力咁操練，終於入選校隊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lok6 lik6 gam3 cou1 lin6 zung1 jyu1 jap6 syun2 haau6 deoi6

rows.note: Use this when diligence chiefly means doing something carefully and with care.

example.english: I prepared this report diligently and did not miss even the smallest detail.
example.traditional: 我用心咁整呢份報告，連細節都冇漏。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sam1 gam3 zing2 ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 lin4 sai3 zit3 dou1 mou5 lau6
